# PDF.js runtime files

This directory vendors `pdfjs-dist` version **5.6.205** from Mozilla's PDF.js project, licensed under Apache-2.0. The complete license text is in `LICENSE`.

Included files: the minified display module and worker, binary CMaps, and standard font data. They are loaded only by HoverGloss's local PDF reader. Source project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
